extracted.intended_audience: representatives of interests (lobbyists), public officials, journalists, researchers and citizens interested in lobbying transparency in France
extracted.subtask_description: Browsing and consulting the French Haute Autorité pour la transparence de la vie publique (HATVP) répertoire of registered representatives of interests and their declared activities; includes counts, recent registrations, declared activities and lists of registrants failing to declare legally-required information.

rubrics_metrics.name: REPRÉSENTANTS D'INTÉRÊTS INSCRITS SUR LE RÉPERTOIRE
rubrics_metrics.description: Count and listing of interest representatives who are registered in the répertoire (example: 'REPRÉSENTANTS D'INTÉRÊTS INSCRITS SUR LE RÉPERTOIRE 3585'). The page presents recent registrants with dates of inscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an index and recent-registration chronology but does not detail the registration criteria on this page. Use this listing to identify who is registered and when.

rubrics_metrics.name: REPRÉSENTANTS D'INTÉRÊTS AYANT DECLARÉ DES ACTIVITÉS
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorisation and listing of registered interest representatives who have declared activities (shows number and recent publishers of declared activities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page records 'Dernières publications' (most recent declared activities) and lists activity descriptions; it does not provide the legal form or content requirements for declarations here.

rubrics_metrics.name: REPRÉSENTANTS D'INTÉRÊTS NE DÉCLARANT AUCUNE DES INFORMATIONS EXIGÉES PAR LA LOI AU TITRE DU DERNIER EXERCICE
rubrics_metrics.description: A specific listing of registrants who did not declare any of the information required by law for the last reporting period (i.e., flagged non-declaration/non-compliance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This signals a compliance standard (legal obligation to declare certain information) but the page itself does not enumerate the precise legal information required; consult the HATVP guidance or relevant statutes for detailed obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Données du répertoire / Open Data / Statistiques
rubrics_metrics.description: The répertoire exposes aggregate metrics (total registrants, registrants who declared activities, total declared activities) and links to Open Data and statistics resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for transparency and reuse; the page is primarily an index/dataset view. It does not on this page provide methodology for how metrics are computed beyond the displayed counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connaître vos obligations et vous inscrire sur le téléservice AGORA
rubrics_metrics.description: Directive for persons/organisations to learn about their legal obligations and to register using the AGORA teleservice (espace déclarant).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural requirement pointer: the page directs potential declarants to the teleservice for registration and declaration, but does not list step-by-step submission requirements or documentation on this page.
